Thus payments provider key expired causing errors that propagate to checkout as 502. We rotated secret. After rotation, check_health returned healthy. That resolves. We need to finish with cause bad_flag? Actually cause: expired_secret. root_cause_service: payments. summary: rotated secret resolved. We should call finish.
